questions.stem_text:
The nebular theory of the formation of the solar system successfully predicts all but one
of the following. Which one does the theory not predict?

options.A: Planets orbit around the Sun in nearly circular orbits in a flattened disk.
options.B: the equal number of terrestrial and jovian planets
options.D: asteroids Kuiper-belt comets and the Oort cloud

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - the equal number of terrestrial and jovian planets

questions.stem_text: The famous Drake equation attempts to answer the following question:

options.A: Will the Sun become a black hole?
options.C: How old is the visible universe?
options.D: Are we alone in the universe?

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Are we alone in the universe?
